subject: bug in newly-released version 0.13.0 affecting MCMC for models with predictive nodes

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: bug in newly-released version 0.13.0 affecting MCMC for models with predictive nodes
parts:
Dear NIMBLE users,

We recently released version 0.13.0, which has some improvements in how we handle predictive nodes in NIMBLE's MCMC engine. 

Unfortunately, we realized (thanks to a user post from a couple days ago) that there is a bug in this new approach to predictive nodes.

If you haven't upgraded to version 0.13.0, simply wait to upgrade until we release a bug fix in 0.13.1 in the next couple weeks.

If you have upgraded to version 0.13.0 and if you run an MCMC on a model that both (1) has predictive nodes and (2) has multivariate nodes, then the bug might affect your results. Please reconfigure/rebuild and rerun your MCMC, making sure to first set:
   nimbleOptions(MCMCusePredictiveDependenciesInCalculations = TRUE)
That will ensure that the MCMC behaves as it would in previous versions of NIMBLE.

-Chris (for the NIMBLE Development Team).
